_comment: Chain-tip anchor and recent fee-rate reference. The device has no RTC and no chain tip, so a block-height nLockTime is uninterpretable on its own and a fee rate has nothing to be judged against. Regenerated by .github/workflows/update-latest-block.yml; safe to hand-edit from any block explorer (e.g. https://mempool.space/block/<hash>). Both values are advisory: they move a displayed estimate and a warning threshold, never a signing decision, so a stale file is harmless.
_max_fee_rate_note: Mean of the highest fee rate seen in each of the last 10 blocks, in sat/vB. Used as the default Max Fee Rate threshold when that setting is on Auto.
